City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 10, 2016 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the December 8, 2015 Special Meeting, January 20, 2016 Regular Meeting and January 27, 2016 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2016-02-10 Item 8A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2016-02-10 Item 8B Warrants
8C.
Adoption of City Council Ordinance No. 2016-01 amending the City's Water Efficient Landscape Regulations (Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 23.26) to comply with the State's updated Model Water Efficient Landscape Ordinance (MWELO) which provides for greater efforts at water conservation and requires much more efficient use of water in landscaping. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Adopt Ordinance No. 2016-01 titled, "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California to amend Chapter 23.26 of the Encinitas Municipal Code, Water Efficient Landscape Regulations, to be consistent with the 2015 State Model Water Efficient Landscape Ordinance (MWELO) Case Number 15-219 POD."
2016-02-10 Item 8C Adoption of Ordinance 2016-01 - Water Efficient Landscape Regulations
8D.
Emergency Repair - Highway 101 Storm Drain and Slope Repair Projects (CX11F & CX16F). Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Hefner
1) Authorize the Public Works Director to execute a contract, in substantial form as contained in Attachment 3, and any necessary amendments, with Wright Construction Engineering Corporation in the amount of $590,805 plus 15% contingencies to construct the Highway 101 Storm Drain and Slope Repair Project, for a total contract amount not to exceed $679,426; 2) Accept an additional grant allocation from the Federal Highway Administration (FHWA) Emergency Repair grant program in order to construct the Highway 101 Storm Drain and Slope Repair Project; and 3) Adopt Resolution 2016-01, authorizing the appropriation of grant funding in the amount of $412,576, General Funds in the amount of $83,925, and Traffic Mitigation Funds in the amount of $64,424 to the Highway 101 Storm Drain and Slope Repair Project (CX11F); and grant funding in the amount of $30,986 and General Funds in the amount of $4,014 to the Highway 101 Slope Repair Monitoring Project (CX16F) (Attachment 1).
2016-02-10 Item 8D Award Contract Highway 101 Emergency Storm Drain and Slope Repair
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Public Hearing to consider an appeal of the denial for a finding of either Public Convenience or Necessity for the 7-Eleven located at 2211 San Elijo Avenue to conduct off-sale of beer and wine (Type 20 ABC license). Case Number: 15-126 PCN; Appellant: 7-Eleven; Appellant: Jennifer Oden of Solomon Saltsman & Jamieson representing 7-Eleven and Bobby Virk, Franchisee. Contact Person: Associate Planner Delcamp
THIS APPEAL WAS WITHDRAWN BY THE APPELLANT/APPLICANT AND ONLY APPEARS ON THE AGENDA BECAUSE IT WAS PUBLICLY NOTICED.
2016-02-10 Item 10A Letter Withdrawing Appeal 7-Eleven
10B.
Presentation of the FY 2015-16 and FY 2016-17 City of Encinitas Work Program for consideration; Resolution No. 2016-07 revising the Salary Table; Introducing Ordinance 2016-02 amending the Title of Chapter 2.28 and various sections within Chapter 2.28 of the Encinitas Municipal Code; approval of Professional Consultant Services Agreements; Resolution 2016-09 amending the FY 2015-16 Budget; and consideration of the Commissions' Workflow Chart. Contact Person: City Manager Brust
Staff recommends that City Council take the following actions:
1. Receive the January 2016 report prepared by Karen Orlansky with Management Partners, summarizing the December 8, 2015 Planning Session;
2. Adopt the City's Work Program for FY 2015-16 and 2016-17 as discussed during the December 8, 2015 City Council Planning Session;
3. Adopt Resolution No 2016-07, a Personnel Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Adopting a Revised Salary Table for Position Titles and Pay Ranges for Fiscal Year 2015-16, which includes the reclassification of the Deputy City Manager classification to that of an Assistant City Manager classification;
4. Approve for introduction Ordinance 2016-02, an Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Title of Chapter 2.28 and Various Sections within Chapter 2.28 of the Encinitas Municipal Code, changing "Cabinet Team Positions and Officers" to "Executive Team Positions and Officers" and reflecting the reclassification of Deputy City Manager to the classification of Assistant City Manager;
5. Approve Agreements for Professional Consultant Services for Communication Services and Urban Planning Services;
6. Adopt Resolution No. 2016-09, a Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2015-16 Budget, adjusting the appropriations to the FY 2015-16 budget necessary for implementation of the City's Work Plan; and
7. Receive revised Commissions' Workflow Chart.
2016-02-10 Item 10B Work Plan Report
10C.
Fire Department Management, Governance and Organizational Evaluation City Council Subcommittee Appointment. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
That City Council appoints Council Member Mark Muir as a representative on the Fire Department Management, Governance and Organizational Evaluation City Council Subcommittee.
2016-02-10 Item 10C Fire Management Appointment

ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON FEBRUARY 17, 2016
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
